## What this changes

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read [`SCOPE.md`](../SCOPE.md) and this adds nothing from the omitted list
- [ ] No malware samples, sample links, or client data included
- [ ] Claims are cited to primary sources, with dates
- [ ] `python -m unittest discover tests` passes, **repeatedly** (see CONTRIBUTING)
- [ ] New behaviour has a regression test
- [ ] No dead internal links

## If this changes a tool

- [ ] Still read-only on input; nothing is modified, renamed, or deleted
- [ ] Still stdlib-only, or the dependency is justified in the PR description
